posts.text:
More than ever it'll be important to get your business as lean as possible I think

Moving from expensive PaaS platforms to your own VPS is usually 100x to 1000x cheaper:

Vultr VPS is $2.50/month
AWS Lightsail VPS is $3.50/mo
DigitalOcean VPS starts at $4/month
Linode VPS starts at $5/month
Hetzner VPS starts at $7/month

Yes that's an entire server you can host your sites on!

Add free Tailscale + free Cloudflare Tunnel + close all firewall ports and you're safe too!
posts.text_zh:
现在比以往任何时候，都更要把生意做得足够精益，我觉得

从昂贵的 PaaS 平台迁到自己的 VPS，通常能便宜 100 倍到 1000 倍：

Vultr VPS 是 $2.50/month
AWS Lightsail VPS 是 $3.50/mo
DigitalOcean VPS 起步价 $4/month
Linode VPS 起步价 $5/month
Hetzner VPS 起步价 $7/month

没错，这就是一整台服务器，你可以把网站托管上去！

再加上免费的 Tailscale + 免费的 Cloudflare Tunnel，并关闭所有防火墙端口，你也一样安全！

Higgsfield gave me $100,000 to realize my dream:

A hackathon where participants build a real business, not just an app.

So... Introducing The $100K Hackathon:
🏴‍☠️ https://t.co/nHDJ5Qruhu 🏴‍☠️

It starts on November 16, and you'll have 30 days to build a startup and make it profitable. The prizes:

🥇 $100,000
🥈 iPhone Duo
🥉 MacBook Neo

This is not a joke. The winner will get $100,000 in cash.

To win, you must:

1. Start a completely new business on Nov 16
2. Build a digital product (SaaS, directory, etc.)
3. Make the most profit (not revenue)

You can already register at $99. When the hackathon starts on Nov 16, you can still join for $149.

I'm running this with my dear friend @jackfriks, and we'll manually review each potential winner to make sure everything holds up.

See you on November 16, builders 🏴‍☠️🫡
